query_en: Who is eligible to receive financial support under the PM-KISAN scheme?
ground_truth_facts: Small and marginal farmer families
Own cultivable land holding in their name
Excludes institutional landholders and income tax payers

query_en: Can a retired government officer with land get PM-KISAN money?
ground_truth_facts: No
Retired government employees with monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more are excluded (except Class IV/Group D)

query_en: Can tenant farmers who do not own land apply for PM-KISAN?
ground_truth_facts: No
Landownership in official State revenue records is mandatory

query_en: What documents are required to register for PM-KISAN?
ground_truth_facts: Aadhaar Card
Land revenue records (Khasra/Khatauni)
Aadhaar-linked active bank account

query_en: Is Aadhaar card mandatory to get PM-KISAN installments?
ground_truth_facts: Yes
Aadhaar is mandatory and must be linked to the bank account for DBT

query_en: What land papers must I show for PM-KISAN registration?
ground_truth_facts: Khasra/Khatauni or official land ownership document issued by State revenue department

query_en: How can I register myself for PM-KISAN online?
ground_truth_facts: Visit pmkisan.gov.in
Go to Farmers Corner -> New Farmer Registration
Enter Aadhaar, mobile number, land survey details and submit OTP

query_en: Where should I go in my village if I cannot apply for PM-KISAN online?
ground_truth_facts: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local revenue officer / Patwari

query_en: What is the procedure for PM-KISAN e-KYC authentication?
ground_truth_facts: Complete OTP-based e-KYC on the portal or biometric e-KYC at a CSC

query_en: How much money does a farmer get per year from PM-KISAN?
ground_truth_facts: Rs. 6,000 per year

query_en: In how many installments is the PM-KISAN amount paid?
ground_truth_facts: Three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every 4 months

query_en: When are the PM-KISAN installments deposited into bank accounts?
ground_truth_facts: April-July, August-November, and December-March tranches via Direct Benefit Transfer

query_en: Is the PM-KISAN assistance paid as cash or sent to bank accounts?
ground_truth_facts: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-seeded bank account

query_en: Who can get work under the MGNREGA scheme?
ground_truth_facts: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work

query_en: Is there any landholding or poverty line limit to work under MGNREGA?
ground_truth_facts: No
All rural households are eligible regardless of landholding or poverty status

query_en: What is the minimum age required to register for MGNREGA work?
ground_truth_facts: At least 18 years of age (adult members)

query_en: What documents do I need to get an MGNREGA Job Card?
ground_truth_facts: Proof of identity (Aadhaar or Voter ID)
Proof of residence in Gram Panchayat
Passport-size photographs
Bank/post office passbook

query_en: Do I need to pay any fee for obtaining an MGNREGA Job Card?
ground_truth_facts: No
The Job Card is issued completely free of cost

query_en: What bank account details are required for MGNREGA wage payments?
ground_truth_facts: Individual or joint bank or post office savings account passbook linked to Aadhaar

query_en: Where do I submit my application for an MGNREGA Job Card?
ground_truth_facts: To the local Gram Panchayat or Programme Officer

query_en: Within how many days should the Gram Panchayat issue a Job Card?
ground_truth_facts: Within 15 days of receiving the application

query_en: How do I request work after getting my MGNREGA Job Card?
ground_truth_facts: Submit a written demand for work to the Gram Panchayat specifying dates; obtain a dated receipt

query_en: How many days of work are guaranteed under MGNREGA per year?
ground_truth_facts: At least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year per rural household

query_en: What happens if the government cannot provide MGNREGA work within 15 days of demand?
ground_truth_facts: The applicant is entitled to a daily Unemployment Allowance paid by the State Government

query_en: Are men and women paid different wages under MGNREGA?
ground_truth_facts: No
Equal wages are legally mandated for both men and women

query_en: How far from the village will MGNREGA work be provided?
ground_truth_facts: Within 5 km radius; if beyond 5 km, an additional 10% wage is paid for travel and living expenses

query_en: Who is eligible for healthcare benefits under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
ground_truth_facts: Families identified in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria (rural D1-D5, D7), specified urban worker categories, and senior citizens 70+

query_en: Are senior citizens above 70 years eligible for Ayushman Bharat regardless of income?
ground_truth_facts: Yes
All individuals aged 70 and above are covered up to Rs 5 lakh annually without income limits

query_en: Can urban street vendors and domestic workers get Ayushman Bharat coverage?
ground_truth_facts: Yes
Street vendors and domestic workers are among the 11 recognized urban occupational categories

query_en: Is there a limit on family size for Ayushman Bharat enrollment?
ground_truth_facts: No limit on family size, gender, or age of members

query_en: What documents are required to make an Ayushman Golden Card?
ground_truth_facts: Aadhaar Card for biometric authentication
Ration card or PMJAY Family Letter
Active mobile number

query_en: Is a Ration card sufficient to verify family details for Ayushman Bharat?
ground_truth_facts: Yes, along with Aadhaar card for individual identity verification

query_en: Do I need to carry original identity cards to the hospital for PMJAY treatment?
ground_truth_facts: Yes, carry the Ayushman card and government photo ID (Aadhaar) to the Ayushman Mitra desk

query_en: How can I check if my name is on the Ayushman Bharat beneficiary list?
ground_truth_facts: Visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in, use the Ayushman App, or check at a local CSC or empanelled hospital

query_en: Where do I go inside an empanelled hospital to avail cashless treatment?
ground_truth_facts: Approach the Ayushman Mitra help desk at the empanelled hospital for patient verification and pre-authorization

query_en: Can I generate my Ayushman Card from a Common Service Centre?
ground_truth_facts: Yes, CSCs provide biometric e-KYC and issue Ayushman PVC cards

query_en: What is the maximum medical cover provided under Ayushman Bharat per family?
ground_truth_facts: Up to Rs. 5,00,000 per eligible family per year on a family-floater basis

query_en: Are pre-existing medical conditions covered from the first day in PM-JAY?
ground_truth_facts: Yes, all pre-existing conditions are covered from day one without waiting period

query_en: Does Ayushman Bharat cover medicine costs after being discharged from the hospital?
ground_truth_facts: Yes, covers up to 15 days of post-hospitalization medications and diagnostic tests
